en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned street curving between a large corner building labeled "HÔTEL DE SA…" on the left and a tree‑lined park with a bust statue on a pedestal on the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand along the street, including children and adults, some with prams or carts. The architecture is European, with three‑story stucco townhouses receding into the distance.
